question: Which identities as Tārkṣya, well-known, and autumnal are affirmed in obeisance to the deity?
premises: The deity is addressed as Tārkṣya.
The deity is addressed as well known.
The deity is addressed as very autumnal.
inference: The deity is honored under the names Tārkṣya, as knowable, and as autumnal.
uncertainties: śāradāya may refer to the goddess Śāradā or to autumnal clarity.
plain_english: Obeisance to Tārkṣya; obeisance to the well-known one; obeisance to the very autumnal one.
